payload.title: Second-pass agreement check on email labels
payload.description:
Measure how reliable the small-model labels are before a person reviews them.

## Steps

- Pick a random 20% of candidate lines across all `ghost` and `saleor` batches.
- Have a second, different small model label them independently from the same reference, into separate packet files.
- Compare with the first labels field by field. Report agreement per field and list every disagreement.
- Disagreements go to the person reviewing those batches, first.
- If agreement on value vs. word is below 90%, stop and revise the labeling reference before more batches are worked.

## Done when

The agreement report is attached and disagreements are adjudicated.
